item.title: Google Workspace Access & ChatGPT Linking
item.description:
15-25 USD/hr | I have a small Google Workspace domain already running, but new staff still can’t see what they need. Your first task is to grant them the right level of access to both our shared email inboxes and the Drive folders we rely on every day. They only need to view and reply to messages and to open files—no editing, deleting, or resharing privileges.
Once that’s sorted, I’d like to connect a few simple website functions to ChatGPT so that certain prompts on the site pull data or trigger responses through the API. The integration itself is straightforward; what’s holding me back is making sure account-level permissions and OAuth scopes on Workspace line up cleanly before I switch the code to production.
Deliverables • Configure user-level permissions so each new staff member can view/reply in shared mailboxes and view files in the designated Drive folders. • Verify that delegated mailbox access and Drive link sharing behave exactly as intended from two test accounts. • Provide concise, step-by-step notes or a short Loom explaining where to repeat these steps for future hires. • Confirm ChatGPT API calls authenticate without exposing broader Workspace scopes, then demonstrate one working website function tied to the model.
If you’re comfortable juggling Google Admin Console settings, IAM/OAuth concerns, and a quick ChatGPT webhook, this should be a smooth engagement.

item.title: WordPress Development & SEO Expert Needed- 7
item.description:
30-250 USD | SEO & WEBSITE DEVELOPER (WordPress) — Remote, Monthly Pay
About Us Our Company helps entrepreneurs start and grow their businesses. Our wordpress website is our storefront, and organic search is a core growth channel. We are hiring one person to own both: keep our WordPress site running perfectly and grow qualified organic traffic that turns into leads, sign-ups, and customers.
Starting Pay $300 USD per month, paid monthly. Pay is earned by completing the listed tasks and metrics on a signed weekly checklist, released after a 4-week+ review, paid upon completion of KPI metrics.
Schedule Flexible remote, fixed hours workday with a 30-minute lunch. Daily short written update to Admin; weekly report every Friday.
What You Will Do
Website Developer (WordPress site health) - Keep every page working perfectly on mobile, tablet, and desktop: no broken layouts, menus, images, links, or forms. - Test login, sign-up, password reset, order buttons, checkout, and all forms end to end. - Keep page speed under 3 seconds and Core Web Vitals green. - Run plugin, theme, and WordPress core updates on staging first, with a current backup, then apply live. - Fix issues the same day or escalate with a screenshot and page URL. - Weekly cross-browser check (Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge).
SEO & Organic Growth - Publish 100 SEO-optimized templated pages per month (25 per week) through our page generator, using our master template. Upkeep and edit master templates as needed. - Do keyword research: long-tail, intent-driven, clustered, one primary keyword per page. - Earn 100 quality backlinks per month (DR 30–50+) through manual outreach. No PBNs, link farms, spam directories, or paid link networks. Paid placements require written approval in advance. - Technical SEO: keep Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs, and Screaming Frog warnings at zero. Fix redirects, 404s, indexing, schema, and speed issues. - Conversion engineering: every page has a clear value proposition, benefit-driven H1, primary call to action, trust elements, and verified event tracking. - First 30 days: establish a documented baseline for organic sessions, leads, registrations, purchases, and conversion rate, and propose weekly/monthly growth targets for approval. Then report baseline vs. target vs. actual every Friday.
Member Website Publishing - Own customer website publishing requests from intake to completion: connect domains, verify DNS and SSL, publish the site, test layouts/forms/links, and confirm completion with the customer. - Set up staging builds and handle customer DNS updates. - Occasional quick WordPress pages or micro-sites using native Gutenberg blocks.
Tools You Will Use WordPress, Rank Math, Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, and our internal SEO dashboard (keyword pipeline, page generator, rank tracker).
Requirements - Proven WordPress experience: themes, plugins, staging, backups, troubleshooting. - Working SEO knowledge: on-page, technical, keyword research, and manual link outreach. - Comfortable in Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs, and Screaming Frog. - Gutenberg block editor experience (no third-party page builders). - Strong written English for daily and weekly reports. - Reliable internet and consistent daily availability. - You own routine fixes yourself and escalate only access, budget, security, or major platform decisions — with evidence and a recommended next step.
How We Measure Success (KPIs) - 100 new quality-checked SEO pages per month - 100 audited quality backlinks per month - Site load under 3 seconds; zero open technical warnings at week end - Weekly acquisition report every Friday; keyword report every Monday - Zero broken pages, forms, or layouts left open past 24 hours - Organic sessions, leads, registrations, and purchases growing against the approved baseline
How To Apply Send: (1) a short intro, (2) links to 2–3 WordPress sites you have managed or built, (3) one example of SEO results you produced (traffic, rankings, or links — with dates), and (4) we will hire on a level 1 which is similar to a paid task. It's 25% of the workload and pay. This will allow the candidate to work towards a level 2 that is fully functioning at 100% workload and pay for this role as promoting up becomes available.

item.title: Full-Service Marketing for Car Sales

item.title: Build Profitable AI Online Business
item.description:
250-750 USD | I’m ready to roll out a brand-new online venture that taps into AI and is capable of bringing in £5–10 k per month, with clear headroom for continued growth. My strongest pull is toward selling digital products or courses and high-value AI-driven services for businesses, yet I’m open to any model you can demonstrate has worked before.
What I expect from you Show me proof—live stores, dashboards, revenue screenshots, testimonials—of previous builds where you took an AI-based idea from concept to consistent cash flow. Tell me exactly what you did, the obstacles you fixed, and why that experience makes you the right partner here.
Scope of work (30-day launch window) • Pinpoint the most viable, proven concept and map the revenue pathway to reach £5–10 k/month. • Validate the market quickly with real data, then build the core offer (course, digital product, or service package). • Set up the tech stack: AI content generation (e.g., ChatGPT, Midjourney), automation via Zapier/Make, sales funnel, payment gateway, email sequences, analytics. • Deliver launch-ready branding, landing pages, and a concise go-to-market plan—including paid/organic traffic strategies—to flip the switch and start selling. • Provide SOPs so the business can scale or be handed off smoothly after launch.
Acceptance criteria 1. A fully functional, client-ownable online asset that is taking payments by Day 30. 2. A documented funnel and automation map showing exactly how AI is used to minimise manual workload. 3. A 90-day growth roadmap that projects the path to £5–10 k/month using realistic KPIs pulled from your earlier successes.
If you’ve built something similar and can replicate or enhance that success with me, I’d like this to grow into an ongoing partnership after the initial build. Pitch your proven idea, attach evidence, and let’s get started.

item.title: Digital Marketing Manager for Toronto Businesses
item.description:
250-750 CAD | Hi,
I'm looking for someone to manage all the digital marketing and websites for two established businesses in Toronto, Canada.
I'm interested in a long-term, part-time arrangement, approximately 15–20 hours per week.
Before moving forward, I have a few questions:
1. Experience: How many years have you worked in digital marketing? Have you managed marketing for Canadian or American businesses?
2. English: Are you fluent in written and spoken English? All our marketing and customer-facing content will be in English.
3. Google Ads: Can you create, manage and optimize Google Ads campaigns, including keywords, targeting, budgets and conversion tracking?
4. Google Ads problems: Can you troubleshoot disapproved ads, website policy violations and deal directly with Google Ads support? We currently have an unresolved Google Ads policy issue.
5. SEO: Can you handle all aspects of SEO, including technical SEO, local SEO, Google Search Console and improving our rankings in Toronto?
6. Google Business Profile: Can you manage and optimize both companies' Google Business Profiles and help improve our visibility on Google Maps?
7. Websites: Can you maintain, update, troubleshoot and improve our websites, including working with WordPress and Hostinger hosting?
8. Social media: Can you completely manage Facebook and Instagram, including creating content, graphics, posts and paid advertising campaigns?
9. Content creation: Would you create the advertising content and graphics yourself, or would we need to provide everything?
10. Results: Can you show me examples of businesses you've managed and measurable results you've achieved, particularly leads generated through Google Ads or SEO?
11. Independent management: Are you comfortable taking responsibility for everything website and digital marketing related, identifying problems and making recommendations without needing daily instructions?
12. Availability: Are you available for approximately 15–20 hours weekly? Would you be working independently or using other freelancers?
13. Reporting: Can you provide weekly progress updates and monthly reports showing website traffic, advertising costs, phone calls, leads and results?
14. Pricing: What fixed monthly fee would you charge to manage both businesses? Would everything mentioned above be included, or would certain services cost extra?
15. Trial period: Would you be interested in starting with a paid 30-day trial so we can evaluate your work before entering a long-term arrangement?
I'm looking for one reliable person who can take ownership of our entire online presence, not just someone who posts on social media.
Please let me know which of these responsibilities you can personally handle and which would require additional assistance.
Thank you.

item.title: Water Treatment Service Website Build
item.description:
30-250 USD | I need a clean, conversion-focused website modeled closely on https://michiganwaterpros.com/ for my local water-treatment business. The core pages will mirror the example’s structure—clear service sections that explain what we do and a straightforward contact form on every page—so visitors can reach out without hunting for the right button.
Beyond that baseline, I want an online booking / quote request form built in, letting customers choose a service, pick a preferred time-frame, and send the request straight to my inbox. The two primary services we must highlight are (1) water testing and complete filtration system installation, and (2) water softeners, reverse osmosis units, and ongoing maintenance. Everything else on the site should steer leads toward requesting one of those options.
Visual style should stay professional and trustworthy—think blues, clean typography, simple iconography—yet you’re free to refine the layout or propose a more modern framework as long as it stays fast, mobile-responsive, and easy for me to update.
Deliverables • Custom WordPress (or comparable CMS) theme replicating the reference site’s user flow • Service pages for the offerings above, each with clear calls to action • Embedded contact form plus a separate booking / quote request workflow tied to email notifications • Basic on-page SEO (titles, meta, schema for local service) • Training hand-off or short video walkthrough so I can edit text and images myself
If you have recent examples of similar local-service sites—especially in plumbing or water treatment—feel free to point me to them when you reply.
